verdict.line: You lose the lane if you force trades into his poke before level 6; you win the game once Relentless Assault and Trinity Force come online.

brief.thesis: Jayce's whole kit outranges Jax's 700-range Leap Strike: Hammer Stance's To the Skies! leap-slow and Thundering Blow knockback punish any approach, and Cannon Stance's Shock Blast through an Acceleration Gate pokes from even further. The lane is a stance-reading game — Jayce is dangerous at range in Cannon Stance and vulnerable the instant he's stuck in melee in Hammer Stance. Jax's 51% win rate over 2,569 games despite Jayce holding the measured lane advantage shows this flips once Jax hits his ultimate and first core item.

theirWindow.when: Cannon Stance with Acceleration Gate down
theirWindow.what: If he fires Shock Blast (Q) through his own Acceleration Gate (E), the missile gains range, speed, and damage. Step off that line instead of trading face-first into it.

yourWindow.when: Right after he leaps in with Hammer Q
yourWindow.what: The moment he lands To the Skies! (Q) in Hammer Stance he's in melee range — immediately pop Counter Strike (E, cooldown 18/16/14/12/10s) to dodge his follow-up auto and stun him for a free Empower (W) hit. Never initiate with your own Leap Strike (Q); he can simply Thundering Blow (E) you straight back out.

start.why: Highest-winrate start (52.1% over 1,717 games) and the better pick vs. Doran's Blade — the flat damage reduction and regen eat into Shock Blast and Thundering Blow chip before you can close distance.

boots.why: 50.8% over 2,187 games and the clear pick (77.1%) — it blunts the free autos he gets from Hyper Charge's attack-speed burst in Cannon Stance.

core.why: The dash-damage and attack speed close the range gap and let your Empower-Q all-in actually land once you're in melee.
Sustain on Counter Strike procs keeps you alive through the poke phase while you scale toward your powerspike.
56.7% over 328 games as the third item — buys out his burst window after you commit to an all-in.

you need to shred his lower base HP and stick through his stance swaps rather than bursting

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest-winrate page for this matchup (48.8% over measured games) — it procs through the slow auto-trades Jayce forces and scales your health pool against his poke.

summoners.why: Highest measured win rate at 52.8% over 32.9% pick rate — since the early lane belongs to Jayce, Teleport lets you reset and apply pressure elsewhere instead of forcing even trades you're likely to lose before level 6.

playing.title: Track his stance every cooldown
playing.detail: Hammer Stance means a melee leap and knockback threat; Cannon Stance means ranged Shock Blast and Gate poke. Knowing which one he's in tells you whether he can actually engage you or is just kiting.

playing.title: Punish the leap, not the knockback
playing.detail: When he commits with To the Skies! (Q) in Hammer Stance, immediately Counter Strike (E) to dodge his follow-up auto and stun him. Never initiate your own Leap Strike (Q) — Thundering Blow (E) just knocks you back out.

playing.title: Don't stand on the Gate line
playing.detail: If he drops Acceleration Gate (E) in Cannon Stance and lines up a Shock Blast through it, the missile gets more range, speed, and damage. Step off that line rather than trading into it.

playing.title: Hold Empower until you're already close
playing.detail: W's cooldown is 7/6/5/4/3s — only spend it on an all-in auto or Leap Strike once you're in stun or kill range, since whiffing it early wastes your best trading tool.

playing.title: Save Counter Strike for melee windows
playing.detail: E only stuns once enemies are in its 300 range — use it reactively right after he leaps or transforms into melee, not as a poke-dodge from distance.

playing.title: Shove waves, don't force trades pre-6
playing.detail: Levels 1-5 favor his poke. Farm safely and push the wave under tower instead of contesting trades; look to flip the lane once Relentless Assault comes online at 6.

playing.title: Start forcing fights post-9
playing.detail: Once Trinity Force components land around level 9-12, your Empower-Q-R burst and sustained attack speed outpace his poke damage — stop farming passively and start all-inning.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win rates/sample sizes are measured OP.GG data from the current patch (16.19.1); the stance-reading tactics and timing calls are our own read on the mechanics.

stats.opponentTip: Use Counter Strike [E] when Jayce uses To the Skies! (Q). Be careful of using Leap Strike [Q] as he can simply push you back with Thundering Blow(E).
